findings.title: Shutdown can falsely report success while processes remain
Generic foundation fixture was challenged as not target-specific
Evidence harness cannot produce complete target execution evidence
Zero-residue oracle proves only a filtered row count
Rollback rehearsal omits required recovery dimensions
Health-only substitute does not prove full application startup side effects are controlled
Package validator runtime is not self-identifying

scope_reconciliation_note: S2A-SR-002 must be reassessed against the Founder directive, which authorizes generic foundation fixtures and prohibits complete Identity, Relationships, Authorization, GP-05, and CP-3 domain fixtures.
